title: Four school students injured in auto-jeep collision in Idukki
content: Four school students sustained serious injuries when the autorickshaw they were travelling in collided with a tourist jeep near Anakulam under the Mankulam panchayat on Tuesday evening around 4.30 PM. ​Those injured are students of St Joseph's School, Mankulam. The accident occurred while the auto that was taking the children home to Kuwait City from school crashed into a jeep carrying tourists from Kallar toward Anakulam. ​The four injured children were rushed to the Adimali Taluk Hospital, where they received first aid. Fortunately, none of their injuries is reported to be life-threatening. ​Locals have raised serious concerns over the reckless driving of tourist vehicles speeding through the route to witness wild elephants bathing at Anakulam. Residents point out that the Mankulam-Anakulam road is extremely narrow, yet tourist vehicles pass through the stretch with no speed controls or restrictions. They noted that this dangerous driving poses a severe threat to children walking home after school, prompting urgent calls for intervention by police personnel at the Mankulam outpost.
